edges.reason: onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner before setOwner executes.
onlyUSDRateSetter requires msg.sender == usdRateSetter.
onlyOperator requires isOperatorFor(msg.sender, _from).
onlyMinter requires tokenState.minters[msg.sender].
onlyLifter requires canLift[msg.sender].
setLiftPermission is gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
setTier1BurnVSC is gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
setPartnerContract is gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
setMintPermission is gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
owner state variable is read and updated by setOwner.
usdRateSetter is read to authorize setUSDRate.
canLift mapping is read to authorize lift.
Token.send dispatches into the overridden doSend implementation.
operatorSend dispatches into the overridden doSend implementation.
super.doSend delegates to LToken.doSend after burn handling.
LToken.doSend calls sendHook before mutating balances.
LToken.doSend calls receiveHook after mutating balances.
sendHook performs an external tokensToSend callback to an arbitrary implementer.
receiveHook performs an external tokensReceived callback to an arbitrary implementer.
tokensToSend hook can re-enter doSend before balances are settled.
tokensReceived hook can re-enter token transfer logic after state updates.
checkProxying invokes ECDSA.recover on the signed proxy hash.
tokensReceived validates proxy data through checkProxying.
tokensReceived performs external this.send and this.operatorSend self-calls.
Self-called send/operatorSend re-enters the token transfer routine.
ECDSA.recover calls the ecrecover precompile.
ECDSA.recover uses inline assembly to extract r, s, v.
_data calldata is abi.decoded inside tokensReceived.
hash parameter flows into ECDSA.recover and ecrecover.
signature parameter flows into ECDSA.recover and signature parsing.
checkProxying assigns the recovered address to the signer local.
tier1BurnVSC ratio is read to compute burnAmount.
doSend assigns the net amount to actualSendAmount.
burnAmount is subtracted from actualSendAmount.
skipTier1Burn mapping gates whether tier1 burn is applied.
_from parameter is used to index skipTier1Burn and forward the send.
_to parameter indexes skipTier1Burn and is the transfer recipient.
_amount parameter is the base amount for burn and send.
_numVSCBurned parameter is validated and stored in tier1BurnVSC.
_numVSCSent parameter is validated (non-zero, <= burned) and stored.
_amount parameter is passed into operatorSend by lift.
_liftAccount parameter becomes the operatorSend source in lift.
_numTokens parameter flows into doSetUSDRate.
_numUSD parameter flows into doSetUSDRate.
_to parameter is forwarded as recipient in Token.send.
_value parameter is forwarded as amount in Token.send.
_owner parameter is validated and written to the owner state variable.
implementer local is resolved from ERC1820 and used for the external call.
implementer local is resolved from ERC1820 and used for the external call.
partnerContracts lookup provides the tier2 scaling manager destination.
proxyProofs mapping is read for uniqueness and written to mark proof used.
tokenState storage is mutated by LToken.doSend balance updates.
lift invokes this.operatorSend, re-entering the operator send path.

normalization_plan.reason: Hash parameter is only meaningful as input to ECDSA.recover.
Signature parameter is parsed solely inside ECDSA.recover.
_data is decoded only within the tokensReceived hook.
Recipient parameter forwards directly into the send transfer path.
Amount parameter forwards directly into the send transfer path.
New owner parameter is consumed exclusively by setOwner.
_from is used only for burn skipping and transfer inside doSend.
_to is used only for burn skipping and transfer inside doSend.
_amount is the base for burn computation inside doSend.
signer local exists solely for the signer == _from check in checkProxying.
burnAmount is a transient local in the burned tier1 computation.
actualSendAmount is the forwarded net amount computed in doSend.
Ratio numerator is validated and stored only by setTier1BurnVSC.
Ratio denominator is validated and stored only by setTier1BurnVSC.
Amount parameter is forwarded into operatorSend by lift.
Lift account parameter is the operatorSend source in lift.
Token count parameter is used only by setUSDRate/doSetUSDRate.
USD amount parameter is used only by setUSDRate/doSetUSDRate.
implementer exists only to target the recipient hook external call.
implementer exists only to target the sender hook external call.
